html:
If you have street-facing windows or your neighbours can see into your home, privacy glass film is the perfect solution. Below we list the benefits of having our privacy film for glass windows installed in your home or office.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network – we have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years, pride ourselves on the service we offer and only ever use high-quality films. Here are the benefits of having our privacy film for glass windows installed

Benefits Of Our Privacy Film For Glass Windows

With privacy glass film you no longer need to draw the curtains or pull the blinds to achieve privacy.

Have peace of mind knowing people can’t see inside your home whilst still being able to enjoy the view (along with the natural light that can still enter your home).

Depending on the type of film you choose, our privacy film for glass windows also offers the following benefits:

  • More comfortable year-round temperatures
  • A reduction in glare
  • Protection from harmful UV rays
  • A reduction in premature fading in furniture, furnishings and flooring

If you have a glass front door and don’t want people to see into your home, reflective glass front door privacy film will stop those on the outside from seeing into your home but you can still see out to see who is at your door.

All privacy glass film installations are done by professionally trained installers and we offer a lifetime warranty on residential applications (up to 15 years on commercial applications).

Our privacy film for glass windows is exclusive to us and is Government-certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Interest-free payment plans are also available through Afterpay and Zip Pay.
